newsitem.title: FRANCE: Matif says ending Globex contract with Reuters.
newsitem.headline: Matif says ending Globex contract with Reuters.

text.p: French financial futures and options exchange Matif SA said on Friday its board had decided to adopt a new electronic trading system, replacing its current Globex system operated by Reuters Holdings Plc.

Matif said it would switch to a new system, NSC, which it is developing jointly with French stock exchanges association SBF. Like Globex, it will be used for electronic trading after floor-trading sessions have ended and as a back-up system.
"The current contract linking Matif SA, the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) and Reuters ends in April 1998," Matif said in a statement.

The Globex electronic trading system was launched in June 1992 and was developed by the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME), the Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) and Reuters. Matif futures contracts started trading on the Globex system in March 1993.
Matif said in the statement: "Matif SA and SBF-Paris Bourse will join forces to develop a trading sub-system especially for futures and options within the Paris market's existing NSC architecture.
"This new sub-system will offer lower costs for operators and members, greater flexibility and a harmonisation of the trading systems used in Paris."
In New York, a spokesman for Reuters said it was working with the CME with a view towards examining the future structure of Globex.

"Reuters has recently become aware of Matif's intention which they announced publicly today. As they said, their plan takes effect at the end of the current Globex contract in April 1998 which of course is slightly more than a year away," Robert Crooke, Reuters America Inc spokesman said.
"In the meantime Reuters is working with the CME with a view towards examining the future structure of Globex," he said.
A CME spokeswoman said it was holding continuing talks with Reuters and Matif.

"As you know we announced last year that we had entered into a two-year contract with Reuters for the Globex system. We are actively exploring a number of options for our electronic trading system following the end of that contract, including discussions with Matif about their new system and discussion with Reuters about continuing with them as a service provider," a CME spokeswoman said.

Matif and the SBF also said they had decided to set up a joint company to manage and expand a range of futures contracts on equity-market indices, including the futures index on France's CAC-40 leading shares. It also planned projected industry or European indices.
